company.name: Kabilah
company.shortDescription: Kabilah is simplifying patient handoff for inpatient nurses.
company.description: Kabilah streamlines shift change for nurses with an AI-powered assistant that replaces paper reports.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered platform designed to support inpatient nursing workflows by automating verbal handoffs, generating digital report sheets, managing tasks, and integrating with EHRs to reduce documentation burden.
productsAndServices.name: Kabilah Platform

productsAndServices.description: A proprietary system within the Kabilah Platform that ensures thorough and accurate verbal handoffs by alerting nurses to missing critical information and correcting inaccuracies during patient transitions.
productsAndServices.name: Consistent & Complete Verbal Handoff Solution

productsAndServices.description: A digital replacement for traditional paper report sheets that consolidates patient information in a clean, accessible format to save time and reduce errors during nursing shifts.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Report Sheets

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven task management tool that generates context-aware ToDo lists prioritizing urgent nursing tasks to streamline workflows and enhance patient safety.
productsAndServices.name: Guided Task Management

productsAndServices.description: A feature that integrates with hospital EHR systems to export report sheets into various note types and flowsheets, reducing redundant documentation for nurses.
productsAndServices.name: EHR Integration for Charting and Flowsheet Completion
